chunks: Ahmad ibn Mihrān narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAbdullāh al-Qallāʾ, from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام mentioned Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام while he was, at that time, a boy, and said: “This newborn is one such that no child born among us has been greater in blessing for our Shiʿah than him.”
Then he said to me: “Do not be estranged from Ismāʿīl.”

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام, referred to in his kunyah
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the speaker in the report
key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلَ: Ismāʿīl, whom the Imam instructed should not be shunned
key_terms.الْمَوْلُودُ: the newborn child being described as especially blessed
key_terms.بَرَكَةً: blessing, divine benefit and goodness bestowed through him
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: our Shiʿah, the followers devoted to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.غُلَامٌ: a young boy, indicating his youthful age at the time

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about the birth and blessing of Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام speaking about Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام in his youth and describing him as an extraordinarily blessed birth for the Shiʿah. It also includes an instruction not to distance or alienate Ismāʿīl, reflecting sensitivity to family and communal relations in the context of the Imam's household.
